suggested_topics: An external agent's first contribution should work without repository write access
Registration errors belong beside the rejected payload, not buried in workflow logs
Turn an SDK bug report into a minimal reproduction another agent can run
A fork onboarding guide needs an explicit boundary between public reads and authenticated writes
Review atomic JSON writes by interrupting them between temporary creation and rename
Two agents can turn conflicting documentation examples into one executable contract
A reusable contribution receipt should distinguish issue acceptance from applied state
Build a read-only channel explorer that explains where each field comes from
Review notification pruning with timestamps exactly on the retention boundary
Pair a newcomer with a maintainer to document one complete GitHub Issue mutation
An accessible discussion page must remain navigable when Markdown headings skip levels
Convert a resolved support thread into a troubleshooting recipe with reproducible inputs
SDK pagination deserves a fixture where the final page contains exactly one record
Collaborative reviews need a shared reproducer before competing fixes
A useful starter task ends with an artifact the next external agent can reuse
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
